audit.whatIsWrong: Chart reads Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs, Skill, Ziggs. The packet chart reads Skill, Maokai, Maokai, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs, Ziggs — and the whys[] agree with the packet: whys[0] calls Level 1 'a wash', whys[1] calls Levels 2-3 'your best window', whys[3] and whys[5] describe eating free poke.
audit.why: The page's own text says the 2-3 window is the only stage Maokai owns, then the chart denies him even that while handing him 4-5 and first item, which the same text describes as the stages where the lane slips away. A 43.08% win rate belongs to Ziggs from Level 4 onward, not from Level 1.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2-3 Maokai, everything from Levels 4-5 onward Ziggs, with ratings re-scaled to match.

audit.why: Spike shape is right — Maokai's only window is 2-3, Level 6 is a setup spike for a jungler rather than a duel spike, and Ziggs's first AP item is where the lane closes.

audit.whatIsWrong: The minefield is called 'his Q minefield' in whys[6] and 'His Q minefield (E)' in spikes[3].text — Bouncing Bomb is the Q, Hexplosive Minefield is the E. Separately, mid asserts that Satchel Charge 'cancels your Twisted Advance dash'.
audit.why: Riot's text gives Satchel Charge a knockback on both Ziggs and the target; nothing in either kit says it interrupts a dash, and Twisted Advance explicitly makes Maokai untargetable while it travels. That is a displacement-versus-untargetable question the kits cannot settle, so the claim should not be on the page as fact. What is solid: Satchel Charge is 20/18/16/14/12s, Hexplosive Minefield is 16s flat at every rank, and Bouncing Bomb is 850 range on 6s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Slots corrected, the dash-cancel claim replaced with Satchel's real cooldown and knock-apart behaviour, and the 850-range poke stated in dontsFull[0].d.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E text and cooldowns

audit.why: Satchel Charge carries a percentHealth derived flag, but Riot's description says only 'deals magic damage'. Per the description-beats-flag rule I made no percent-max-HP claim about it. The packet's suspectName hit on 'Sap Magic's' in wants.foe[0] is a false positive — that is Maokai's own passive, correctly named.

edits.after: His minefield (E) and Satchel siege out-damage your healing for good — you're a teamfight flank tank now, not a laner.

edits.before: His Q minefield (E) plus W siege out-damage Sap Magic forever; you exist only to flank with R in fights, never to win the lane 1v1.
edits.after: Hexplosive Minefield (E) plus Satchel siege out-damage Sap Magic forever; you exist only to flank with R in fights, never to win lane.

edits.before: This is where the lane slips away. At 6 your R (Nature's Grasp) is your one trick — a long, terrain-ignoring root you can fire from a flank or around a wall to set up your jungler, because you will never walk him down in a straight line. But his W (Satchel Charge) cancels your Twisted Advance dash and his E minefield walls off his retreat, so a clean solo all-in basically requires Flash or a gank. Use E to clear his minefield before you step on the wave, and respect that every trade he takes from max range, you lose.
edits.after: This is where the lane slips away. At 6 your R (Nature's Grasp) is your one trick — a long, terrain-ignoring root you can fire from a flank or around a wall to set up your jungler, because you will never walk him down in a straight line. But Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and knocks the two of you apart, and Hexplosive Minefield walls off his retreat, so a clean solo all-in needs Flash or a gank. Clear the mines with E before you step on the wave, and respect that every max-range trade is one you lose.

notes: The chart was inverted in an unusual way here: it took away the two stages Maokai actually wins (2-3) and gave him two he loses (4-5, first item). Also removed an unverifiable claim that Satchel Charge cancels Twisted Advance — Maokai is untargetable during that dash, and nothing in either kit resolves whether a knockback interrupts it. That interaction is worth a definitive answer since it also governs Maokai vs every other displacement top laner.
